question: Whose mantras are included as objects of contemplation, O Pārvatī?
premises: The mantras of guru and deity are included.
The mantra of Maheśa is also included.
inference: Contemplation includes the mantras of guru, deity, and Maheśa.
plain_english: O Pārvatī, this includes the mantras of the guru, the deity, and also of Maheśa.
